visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large green grasshopper is positioned vertically on the exterior of a glass window at night. Its long, translucent green legs are splayed out, with the tiny hooks at the ends of its feet gripping the smooth surface. The background consists of a dimly lit interior room with a dark wooden frame and some blurred white objects. (2) The camera transitions to an extreme close-up of the grasshopper's head. Its large compound eyes are visible, and its complex mouthparts move rhythmically as if it is nibbling on something on the glass. The vibrant green color of its exoskeleton is highly saturated under the artificial light coming from inside. (3) The grasshopper raises one of its slender front legs to its head, carefully pulling one of its long, thin antennae down to clean it with its mandibles. This grooming behavior is captured in detail, showing the insect's flexibility and the precision of its movements against the dark night background. (4) The scene shifts to a side profile view of the grasshopper. Its long, segmented body and folded wings are prominently displayed. It continues to manipulate its mouthparts against the glass, occasionally shifting its weight. The lighting remains constant, highlighting the textures of its wings and the joints in its legs.
